snippet.title: In Conversation with Harry Potter and the Cursed Child Producers, Writer and Director
snippet.description:
An extraordinary meeting took place in London!

Hosted by Angellica Bell, producers Sonia Friedman and Colin Callender, writer Jack Thorne and director John Tiffany, the minds behind the magic gathered to celebrate a decade of memories in the West End and what adventures await in the future for the production.
